is_anopheles.evidence: The study investigates gene expression profiling of the major malaria vector Anopheles funestus (Page 1, Abstract and Introduction).

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study performs RNAseq on lab strains and identifies SNPs including CYP6P9b N384S, but does not genotype any of the specific target resistance markers listed (Page 1, Abstract; Page 7).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable genotype/allele counts or frequencies from field populations are reported; only comparative RNA-seq variant analyses between laboratory colonies are provided.

african_field_population.evidence: Only laboratory-adapted colonies (the resistant strain FUMOZ and susceptible strain FANG) were used: 'Two An. funestus laboratory colonies were used in this study. The FANG colony is a fully insecticide susceptible colony derived from Angola... The FUMOZ colony is a multi-insecticide resistant colony derived from southern Mozambique' (Page 2, Materials and methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: The paper reports a primary empirical RNAseq transcription profiling investigation comparing FUMOZ and FANG strains.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field mosquito collections were conducted in this study.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collection dates are reported for this study.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Re-uses three previously published FANG RNAseq libraries from Weedall et al. 2015 alongside newly sequenced FUMOZ RNAseq libraries, but no field dataset overlap.

supplement.evidence: The study does not analyze field populations in either the main text or supplementary material.

assessment.summary: This study performed RNAseq gene expression profiling and variant detection contrasting two Anopheles funestus laboratory colonies (the pyrethroid-resistant FUMOZ and susceptible FANG). It did not test African field populations or genotype eligible target resistance markers.
exclusion_reasons: Only laboratory colonies were used (FUMOZ and FANG); no African field populations were tested.
Does not report genotyping for any of the target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data for mosquito populations.
